about: Every image and sound in poem 04's passage, where it came from, what it does, and what was looked at and not used.

used.what: her recorded reading of poem 04, 362.0-396.0 s on the suite clock (the passage uses 364.0-392.6 s)
used.role: the clock: every state starts on one of her words (p04_hands/voice/p04_words.json, faster-whisper small)

used.what: Eagle Has Landed: The Flight of Apollo 11 (1969), 10.1 s clip, 29.97 fps, 720x486, silent in the library
used.role: matched to poem 04 by the cineosis cels cut (patches P04-011, P04-012). Used twice: (1) WIPE: its sky, assembled from its frames, wipes down into the plate's sky on 'clouds meet stars'; (2) CITIZEN: the man at the ship's rail, frames 256-304, rises as a cut-out on a stick behind the ledge and his film plays from 'find'
used.treatment: sky: per-pixel median of sky pixels over all 305 frames, eroded, gaps filled by normalised blur (RETOUCHED). man: one fixed scissor cut (the union of his masks), scaled 1.32, paper ring; his frames untouched inside it. Never named: tagged A MAN AT A SHIP'S RAIL

used.what: WYGWYL poem_04 AI video, keyframe 84: a night garden of glass spires
used.role: the set. Its sky is masked (set/sky_mask.png) so the 1969 sky only lands where the plate has sky; its bottom-right rock and plants are cut out as the ledge (set/ledge.png) the citizen hides behind

used.what: the POET cardboard puppet parts registered for p07
used.role: her body; the leg parts gain toe, heel and kneecap sockets for the kneel

used.what: her second hand, open, generated as a companion to the pinch hand
used.role: hand B: lies on the ground, is carried by hand A, goes onto the far wrist
used.treatment: cut from white, scaled to 1.12x the pinch hand's wrist-to-fingertip

used.what: room tone, knee thuds, pats, dust ticks, brad snaps, paper taps, stick slide
used.role: one sound per logged contact; one tick per dust particle as it lands
used.treatment: synthesised; no archive audio (the clip is silent and nothing is put in the man's mouth)

looked_at_not_used.what: the rest of clip 6bb6d333 (frames 1-255: the ship, the sea, the crowd at the rail)
looked_at_not_used.why: the turn and the laugh at 256-304 are the only beat that answers 'find a way to celebrate'
the identification is not verified from the clip or its page; he is tagged by what is seen

looked_at_not_used.what: the clip's sky as a full-frame plate
looked_at_not_used.why: it is muddy where few frames show sky; only its top part is used, and only inside the plate's sky mask
